title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis)
summary: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API provides gap-free hourly reanalysis weather data from ERA5 (0.25°, from 1940), ERA5-Land (0.1°, from 1950) and ECMWF IFS (9 km, from 2017). For the Milan area (45.4642°N, 9.19°E), it returns hourly temperature_2m (°C) and relative_humidity_2m (%) among many other variables. Both target windows (prototype 2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04 and production 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31) are fully covered. The API is open-data under CC BY 4.0, requires no authentication, and is registered and approved for both prototyping and production use.

fields.name: relative_humidity_2m
fields.description: Relative humidity at 2 metres above ground

schema.notes: The API returns nearest ERA5-Land grid cell for the given coordinates (response showed 45.448154°N, 9.169279°E for Milan 45.4642°N, 9.1900°E). Many more hourly variables available: dewpoint, apparent_temperature, precipitation, rain, snowfall, pressure, cloud cover, wind, etc. All variables are documented at https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api

temporal.refresh_cadence: static (reanalysis data; historical archive updated periodically but not on a live schedule)

spatial.notes: API accepts any lat/lon globally; returns nearest grid cell. For Milan area (45.4642, 9.1900), the actual cell returned is (45.448154, 9.169279). ERA5-Land resolution is ~0.1° (~9 km). Temperature and humidity at a single point therefore represent the grid-cell average, not a local station reading.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0
licence.attribution_text: Attribution required: any location where Open-Meteo data are displayed must include a link such as Weather data by Open-Meteo.com
licence.evidence: https://open-meteo.com/en/licence — states 'API data are offered under Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)'. Open-Meteo's upstream data sources (DWD, ECMWF, NOAA, CMC, MeteoFrance, JMA, etc.) have their own licences (mostly CC-BY, some CC-BY-SA, some other open licences), making this a mixed-source work.

declared_metadata.variables: temperature_2m and relative_humidity_2m confirmed via probe
declared_metadata.model: ERA5-Land (0.1° resolution) for pre-2017 data; ECMWF IFS (9 km) from 2017

documentation_excerpts: Gap-free and consistent historical weather data using weather reanalysis from ERA5 (0.25°, from 1940) and ERA5-Land (0.1°, from 1950) and ECMWF IFS (9 km, from 2017) — https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api
API data are offered under Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) — https://open-meteo.com/en/licence

Open-Meteo utilises open-data from various national weather services including: ... Weather reanalysis, air quality forecasts and elevation data from Copernicus Climate Change Service C3S (Licence) — https://open-meteo.com/en/licence
quality_notes: ERA5/ERA5-Land reanalysis data are model-derived, not station observations — temperature and humidity at a point are grid-cell averages (~9 km resolution). Local microclimatic effects (e.g. urban heat island, valley inversions) are not captured at full fidelity.
API response showed elevation 147.0 m at Milan coordinates; actual elevation in central Milan is ~120 m — small discrepancy from grid averaging.

The API automatically selects the best available model per date range: ERA5-Land for 1950-2016, ECMWF IFS for 2017-present. This means different model resolutions apply across the two windows (prototype 2004-2005 uses ERA5-Land at ~9 km; production 2024-2025 uses ECMWF IFS at ~9 km).
Upstream data sources have diverse licences (CC-BY, CC-BY-SA, other open licences) — see mixed_sources = true.
Register default coordinates were already set to Milan (45.4642, 9.1900) — the suspected issue about Lisbon coordinates is resolved.
